text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-con structure with \"First of all\" and \"Second\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly sequenced into distinct points that build the argument in an easy-to-follow order."},{"evidence":"\"According to the text...\" and direct quotation about cost and liability","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses relevant evidence from the article to back up its claims more consistently and precisely."},{"evidence":"\"Needing a human driver at all defeats the purpose\"","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay more directly explains how the evidence supports its position instead of only stating opinions."},{"evidence":"\"They are not actually one-hundred percent driverless, and therefore virtually pointless\"","quality":"focus","description":"The essay stays more tightly centered on a single argument against driverless cars and avoids drifting into side comments."},{"evidence":"consistent concluding restatement of the main claim","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a more complete wrap-up that restates the position and summarizes the reasons."}]}
